verdicts.title: Multiplicative differential algebraic K-theory and applications
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We construct a version of Beilinson's regulator as a map of sheaves of commutative ring spectra and use it to define a multiplicative variant of differential algebraic K-theory. We use this theory to give an interpretation of Bloch's construction of K_3-classes and the relation with dilogarithms. Furthermore, we provide a relation to Arakelov theory via the arithmetic degree of metrized line bundles, and we give a proof of the formality of the algebraic K-theory of number rings.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses multiplicative differential algebraic K-theory, Beilinson's regulator, and Arakelov theory for number rings—it makes no mention of Frege proofs, proof depth, matroids, or Boolean circuits. It shares only the 'algebraic K-theory' vocabulary with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: G-theory of root stacks and equivariant K-theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Using the description of the category of quasi-coherent sheaves on a root stack given in the paper of N. Borne and A. Vistoli, we study the G-theory of root stacks via localisation methods. We apply our results to the study of equivariant K-theory of algebraic varieties under certain conditions.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses G-theory of root stacks and equivariant K-theory of algebraic varieties, with no mention of Frege proof depth, Boolean circuits, matroids, or any proof-complexity connection. It shares only the broad 'K-theory' vocabulary with the conjecture.
